ambiguities.statement: Slot mapping follows section 24 number; every renamed ability and hero name is GUESS (theme only).
Sigma costs and value tiers are UNVERIFIED; export preserves them verbatim as tier_values.
Ability 3 costs 0 when passive and 50 when aura, but individual rows do not label passive versus aura. Export records both branches and does not choose one.
Default damage types are UNVERIFIED; a kit row can name another type. Export records defaults, not per-row overrides.
Wojak ultimate instant-kill threshold is below 25% health and is explicitly UNVERIFIED.
Forever three-stun clip is explicitly UNVERIFIED.
Hero and pair lines stay under twelve words; cap UNVERIFIED.
Per-line voice cooldown is 8 s and marked GUESS; balance pass sets it.

Plan/25 historically discusses hero_id 001 to 032 with no gaps, while ROSTER.md and plan/00 authority use slots 001,002,004-027. Export uses oscraft acronyms as engine hero IDs and keeps slot separately.
First-playable slice cuts talents; later full sets are in section 21. Export includes named talent rows where present but does not infer launch talent values.
